title: session.continued@1
description: The core sent a stopped session's turn back by itself: once after a dropped connection or a rate limit, once after a context overflow (compacted first), or when the one task its stop raised closed. Only the core appends it; the hub routes the continue when it reads the event.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

stop.description: The agent.stop event this continue answers: the session's newest stop when the core decided.

x-closure.closed: each value is a rule the core applies and the hub acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

because.description: Why it continues: a dropped connection or rate limit, once per turn you started; a context overflow, compacted once and re-sent; or the task its stop raised closed.

task.description: The task whose closing resumed the session, when because is task_closed; null otherwise.
